response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copy_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.copy_count) AS total_copies, AVG(rc.copy_count - ra.avg_copy_count) AS avg_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.copy_count > ra.avg_copy_count
